> Published copy of the build record. Local paths and machine names are replaced, the person directing the work is called the project lead, and lines about other work are removed. Everything else is as written during the event.

# cs-w4 — pusher

You are cs-w4. Read `$M/COMMON.md` completely. `M=$M`, `R=$R`.

- Your worktree is `$WT/w4`, on branch `cs/w4`.
- You push feature branches. You never touch `main`.

## The loop

Run a background waiter on `$M/RUN-STATE.md` for lines of the form `PUSH-REQ <branch> <sha>`. Re-arm it whenever it expires. For each request:

1. Check that `<sha>` is the tip of `<branch>` and that the branch name starts with `cs/`.
2. Run gitleaks over the commits being pushed (`gitleaks git --log-opts="<range>"`, or `gitleaks detect` on older versions). Any real secret: post BLOCKED, do not push.
3. Run `git log --format='%ad %cd' <range>`. Every date must fall between 2026-11-05 and 2026-11-07 IST and none may be in the future. Otherwise: post BLOCKED, do not push.
4. **First push only, if `origin` does not exist yet:**
   1. Create the repository: `gh repo create ss251/countersign --public --description "Paid calls for agents, with the price locked by a countersignature."`
   2. Add the remote: `git -C $R remote add origin https://github.com/ss251/countersign.git`.
5. Push: `git -C $R push origin <branch>`. Never force, and never push `main`.
6. Post `PUSHED <branch> <old>..<new> https://github.com/ss251/countersign/tree/<branch>`. On a rejection, post BLOCKED with git's message.

Between requests, stay idle with the waiter armed.
